notes: RESTRICTED-USE. Use ONLY on Xtend-traited soybeans + cotton. Phase 11 trait override: the kernel allows engenia on the Xtend-traited soybean cultivar; dicamba (synthetic-auxin) would otherwise be lethal to the legume family. Strict label requirements: TTI nozzles, ≤10 mph wind, no tank mix outside approved list, sensitive-crop downwind buffer.
